en: Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a busy European urban square with a central garden and fountain in the foreground, surrounded by grand multi‑storey buildings with awnings and shops at street level. In the background a richly decorated baroque church tower dominates the scene. The top margin contains printed titles and handwritten script, and there is small printed text along the bottom edge.
